python.notes: Python 3.12.10 is the last 3.12 release with an official Windows installer. Python 3.12.16 is source-only. The release page publishes MD5. SHA-256 was recorded from that official amd64 file after its MD5 matched the published digest. An existing Python 3.12 or newer is kept. A missing runtime is installed per-user to %LOCALAPPDATA%/Programs/Python/Python312 and the gateway uses that python.exe.

ollama.notes: Stable release v0.40.14. The SHA-256 is the GitHub release asset digest. The Ollama library tag has no separate checksum in this file, so the pull requires explicit consent. The installer executable is run locally after the hash and Authenticode checks.

comfyui.notes: Official Windows portable NVIDIA archive from the v0.41.0 release. The SHA-256 is the GitHub release asset digest. The embedded interpreter stays inside this tree.

seven_zip.notes: Official standalone 7zr.exe from the ip7z/7zip 26.05 GitHub release. The SHA-256 is that release asset digest. Downloaded only when tar.exe cannot extract the ComfyUI archive and 7z.exe is not already installed.

comfy_models.notes: FP4 text encoder at an immutable Hugging Face revision. qwen_3_4b.safetensors is a different full-size file and is not a substitute. This pin does not claim the FP8 diffusion model and this encoder reside together in 8 GB of VRAM. ComfyUI offloading and a run on the RTX 4060 are still required.
